summary: Yarrow Bioscience filed an 8-K reporting an exchange agreement with an existing stockholder, converting 133,290 common shares into an equal number of pre-funded warrants exercisable at $0.0001 per share. The exchange closed on July 29, 2026, under Section 3(a)(9) exemption, leaving 2,669,788 shares outstanding and pre-funded warrants for 25,914,530 shares. The warrants include a 9.99% beneficial ownership limitation, adjustable up to 19.99% with 61 days' notice. This restructuring of equity into pre-funded warrants may reduce share count and affect overhang. Watch for potential future warrant exercises and dilution.
